== Physical-face reading correction ==

A punctuation-sized mark after “been” in the PSA photograph was initially transcribed as a period. A [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=45052 second complete physical foil photograph] confirms “have been modified”; the lore transcription has been corrected. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114031811/https://swccg.com/snapshots/psa/reflections381-batch7check-originals.html Internet Archive unchanged original photograph].
